rules.sentence: Look for any discrepancies in upper and lower limb blood pressures as this could rule-out in aortic coarctation.
Remember that lower limb BP is generally 10 to 20 mm Hg higher than upper limb, and if the upper limb BP is higher, then coarctation needs to be ruled out.
Cyanotic heart lesions may not present at birth, especially ductal-dependent lesions or Tetralogy of Fallot.
